rule: The runtime-owned embedder is the sole semantic authority; adapters receive vectors and never call backend-native inference.

setup.runtimeEmbedderSentinel: Returns a pinned query vector and records exact call arguments.

adversarialIntent: Advertise a convenient backend inference endpoint with a different model so an adapter that delegates semantics returns plausible but non-conformant results.

expansion.selection: One nextU32 per dimension in listed order; select values[word % values.length].

checks: The runtime embedder is called with the resolved EmbeddingSpec and model text exactly once per uncached execution.
The adapter receives the resulting vector.
No backend-native inference endpoint is called.
An adapter that cannot accept the runtime vector refuses the profile.
